message.text: An invoice (INVOICE) must contain information on PAYMENT INSTRUCTIONS (BG-16).
The group 'SELLER CONTACT' (BG-6) must be transmitted.
The element 'Seller city' (BT-37) must be transmitted.
The element 'Seller post code' (BT-38) must be transmitted.
The element 'Buyer city' (BT-52) must be transmitted.
The element 'Buyer post code' (BT-53) must be transmitted.
The element 'Buyer reference' (BT-10) must be transmitted.
'Specification identifier' (BT-24) should syntactically match the XRechnung standard identifier.
The invoice should state the delivery/service date: BT-72 'Actual delivery date', BG-14 'Invoicing period', or BG-26 'Invoice line period' on every line.
